LanguageData.RF_VersionMismatch: {0} has Rim Factions {1}, you have {2}.\n\nPlaying together needs exactly the same version on every PC, or games break (missing colonists, desyncs). Close RimWorld, run the Rim Factions Updater (Install / Update) on both PCs, then start again.
LanguageData.RF_VersionMismatchShort: Version mismatch: {0} has Rim Factions {1}, you have {2}. Both run the Updater before playing together.
LanguageData.RF_FilesDiffer:
Your mod files are different from the host's.

Don't press "Connect anyway": with different files the two games run different code, and things break (the host's colonists can vanish, desyncs). Instead:

1. Open the Files tab in this window: it lists the mods that differ.
2. Rim Factions, Multiplayer or Prepatcher listed: run the Rim Factions Updater on both PCs (yours: {1}).
3. Workshop mods listed: in Steam, Library > Downloads, let updates finish on both PCs; if one still differs, unsubscribe and resubscribe to it.

Your mods don't match {0}'s ({1} different). Joining {0} would make Multiplayer restart your game with their mods every time.
Switch to {0}'s mod list now? RimWorld restarts once, and after that joining is quick. Your own list is saved and can be restored.

LanguageData.RF_DesyncSendAsk:
Your games went out of sync. Rim Factions can send this desync report to the mod's author so the cause can be found and fixed.
It contains your Multiplayer username, the game's log (with your mod list and file paths) and what the game was doing when it split. It goes to the author's private Discord channel and is used only to fix desyncs.
LanguageData.RF_DesyncSendFailed: Couldn't send the desync report (no connection?). It's still in your MpDesyncs folder.
